stem: Planning that covers a period of 15 to 20 years is called:
exam_explanation: Match the time span: annual = 1 year, medium = about 5 years, perspective/long-term = 15-20 years. Trap: 'medium-term' is the 5-year plan.
plain_explanation: Planning far into the future (like planning a whole city for the next 20 years) is called long-term or perspective planning.

stem: Who was the first Governor-General of Pakistan?
exam_explanation: Pakistan came into being on 14 Aug 1947 and Jinnah took office as its first Governor-General. Trap: Liaquat was the first Prime Minister, Nazimuddin the second Governor-General.
plain_explanation: The leader of the freedom movement became the first head of the new country.
